company.name: Anjuna
company.shortDescription: Anjuna enables organizations to securely embrace the cloud by leveraging confidential computing technologies without changing applications.
company.description: Anjuna makes the public cloud secure for business. Software from Anjuna Security effortlessly enables enterprises to safely run even their most sensitive workloads in the public cloud. Unlike complex perimeter security solutions easily breached by insiders and malicious code, Anjuna leverages the strongest hardware-based secure computing technologies available to make the public cloud the safest computing resource available anywhere
